CastleParcel

Sealed in the keep. Only your link gets in.

What is this?

CastleParcel is a self-hosted file sharer for big files, without accounts or a size paywall. Open the page, drop your files, choose how long they stay and how often they can be downloaded, and share a short link or a QR code. Everything is encrypted in your browser before it uploads, so the server only ever stores ciphertext. It runs as one small container and is set up entirely from the Unraid template.

CastleParcel used to be called featherdrop. If you run featherdrop, open the container's settings, change the Repository to junkerderprovinz/castleparcel:latest and leave the paths as they are. Your shares and every link you sent keep working.

Highlights & Features

  • Zero-knowledge: files and their names are encrypted in the browser with libsodium (XChaCha20-Poly1305), and the key travels in the part of the link after the #, which browsers never send to the server
  • An optional password on top of the link, to send over a second channel
  • Expiry from one hour to 30 days or never, and an optional download limit. A download counts when it starts, and one that breaks off picks up where it stopped
  • Several files under one link, saved as one ZIP, plus encrypted text notes and file requests, where someone sends you files without an account
  • A private management link to delete a share early
  • Resumable uploads in 64 MiB chunks, so big files and size-capped proxies such as Cloudflare are fine
  • Previews for images, video, audio, text and PDF, and photos lose their EXIF and GPS data before they are encrypted
  • 26 languages, light and dark, and your own name, logo and accent colour through the template
  • Rate limits, a storage quota, an expiry cap and an optional upload password for an instance on the internet
  • A client you can check: every release lists the hash of each file, and a script compares a running instance against it
  • Images: junkerderprovinz/castleparcel:latest on Docker Hub and ghcr.io/junkerderprovinz/castleparcel:latest, for amd64 and arm64

Requirements

  • Unraid 6.10+
  • HTTPS in front of it before you share links outside your network. Set BASE_URL to the public address so the links point there. Over plain HTTP an upload still works, but it cannot pick up again after a break
  • Let large uploads through your reverse proxy, for example client_max_body_size 0 and long timeouts in Nginx

Bugs, Problems, Wishes

Something not working, a question or an idea? The best place for it is an issue on GitHub: github.com/junkerderprovinz/castleparcel/issues. Everything stays in one place there, and nothing gets lost in a long thread.

For a bug, whether you post it there or here, these help:

  • Unraid version (Settings → System Information)
  • Image tag (latest or a pinned version)
  • Output of docker logs --tail 200 CastleParcel
  • The browser and operating system on both ends, the sender's and the recipient's
  • Whether you changed BASE_URL, the expiry settings, the branding or the /data and /config paths

Credits

A much smaller take inspired by Pingvin Share. Built with Go on libsodium for the encryption, tus for resumable uploads and SQLite, with a Vue client and the castle loader animated in Rive. If CastleParcel saves you a trip to someone else's cloud, you can buy me a coffee.

Self-hosted, AGPL-3.0 licensed: you run it, you own your data and the responsibility.
